description: Java class 'NonsenseGenerator' that creates random news headlines and articles by assembling sentences with predefined word lists and randomization.

classes.name: NonsenseGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates random news headlines and articles with methods to produce sentences and text.

methods.name: makeSentence
methods.description: Creates a sentence, formatted as a headline or not based on parameter.

methods.name: makeText
methods.description: Generates a block of news text with a specified number of sentences.

methods.name: generateSentence
methods.description: Builds a sentence by adding time clauses, agents, and predicates.

methods.name: generateTimeClause
methods.description: Adds a time-related phrase to the sentence.

methods.name: generateAgent
methods.description: Adds an agent (person or thing) to the sentence.

methods.name: generatePredicate
methods.description: Adds a predicate (verb and object) to the sentence.

methods.name: pickOneOf
methods.description: Selects a random option from provided string options.

methods.name: joinWords
methods.description: Concatenates list of words into a sentence string.
